title: Norwegian Cucumber Soup
description: A refreshing and light soup from Norway, perfect for a cold day. This recipe combines the sweetness of cucumbers with the rich flavor of Norwegian broth.

ingredients.name: Norwegian broth
ingredients.notes: you can find this in most supermarkets or make your own

ingredients.name: lush
ingredients.notes: you can use any green leafy herb like parsley or dill

instructions: Heat the Norwegian broth in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the sliced cucumbers to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes, or until they are tender.
Add the lush to the pot and cook for 2-3 minutes, or until the leaves are wilted.
Use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the soup hot, garnished with additional lush if desired.
